name: General Inquiry Agent
headline: Answer the common question before it becomes a queue.
prompt: What information can I find for you?
description: Provides grounded answers about services, policies, locations, hours, and eligibility. It is a reusable entry scenario when source ownership, freshness, citations, and escalation are clearly defined.
readiness: Illustrative workflow; validate source freshness, answer accuracy, citations, accessibility, and human escalation.

business.application: Provide trusted answers to common questions about services, policies, locations, hours, and eligibility.
business.roi: Reduce repetitive calls and make accurate information available outside staffed hours.
business.metrics: Call deflection · Answer accuracy · Escalation rate

technical.systems: Approved content · Website or knowledge base · Telephony
technical.build: Content grounding, freshness controls, answer citations, fallback, and human transfer.

expected.description: Poster image for the video player (WebP).
